preview.text: South Korea and Indonesia meet in a T20 match at Yeonhui Cricket Ground, where South Korea won the toss and chose to bowl first. In their 9 recorded T20 meetings, South Korea won 2 and Indonesia won 7. The usual first-innings score in the 23 recorded T20 matches at this venue is 119.

summary.text: South Korea won by 9 wkts after restricting IDN innings to 105-9, where Gede Priandana was the top scorer with 40 off 32 balls and Aamir Lal took 3 for 11. In response, SKR innings reached 110-1 led by top scorer Balage Dilruksha with 73 off 52 balls, while Gede Arta took 1 for 19.
